text.tr: XSS'te kullanıcının metni nerede kod gibi yorumlanır?
text.en: Where is the user's text interpreted as code in XSS?

explanation.en: It runs with the site's authority.

text.en: Who is harmed by XSS?

en: Other users who open the page

explanation.en: Whoever wrote the comment runs code for its readers.

text.en: What can a leaked script do?

tr: Sayfayı okuyabilir, kullanıcı adına istek gönderebilir, HttpOnly olmayan çerezlere erişebilir
en: Read the page, send requests in the user's name, reach non-HttpOnly cookies

explanation.tr: O sitenin bir parçası gibi çalışır.
explanation.en: It runs as if part of that site.

text.en: Where does the text come from in stored XSS?

en: From a value saved in the database

explanation.en: It is served to everyone who opens the page.

text.tr: Yansıtılan (reflected) XSS'te kurbanın ne yapması gerekir?
text.en: What does the victim need to do in reflected XSS?

explanation.tr: Metin istekten gelip aynı cevapta geri yazılır.
explanation.en: The text comes from the request and is written back in the same response.

text.en: What is different about DOM-based XSS?

tr: Sunucu karışmaz; sayfanın kendi JavaScript'i metni HTML olarak yazar
en: The server is not involved; the page's own JavaScript writes the text as HTML
It only happens in the database

explanation.en: The root cause is still the same.

text.en: What is the first defence against XSS?

explanation.en: The HTML equivalent of the SQL parameter.

text.en: What does `html.escape` turn `<` into?

explanation.tr: Ekranda yine `<` görünür ama etiket olarak okunmaz.
explanation.en: It still shows as `<` but is not read as a tag.

text.en: Why is `&` converted too in encoding?

tr: Yoksa `<` yazan birinin metni ekranda `<` olarak çıkar
en: Otherwise the text of someone who typed `<` shows as `<`

explanation.en: `&` is encoded first.

text.tr: Bağlantı adresinde (`href`) HTML kodlamaya ek olarak ne denetlenir?
text.en: What is checked in a link address (`href`) besides HTML encoding?

explanation.en: An address starting with `javascript:` runs a script.

text.en: In the lesson, what happened to the `javascript:showPopup()` address?

en: No link was made, only the text remained
It was encoded and became a link

explanation.en: The scheme was not in the allow list.

text.tr: Öznitelik değeri içinde tırnak neden kodlanır?
text.en: Why is a quote encoded inside an attribute value?

tr: Değerden taşıp yeni bir öznitelik açmasın diye
en: So it cannot break out of the value and open a new attribute

explanation.tr: Değer her zaman tırnak içinde yazılır.
explanation.en: The value is always written in quotes.

text.tr: `<script>` bloğunun içine kullanıcı verisi için kural nedir?
text.en: What is the rule for user data inside a `<script>` block?

tr: Yazılmaz; gerekirse veri başka bir yerden okunur
en: It is not written there; if needed the data is read from elsewhere

explanation.tr: Tek bir kaçış fonksiyonu her bağlamı korumaz.
explanation.en: A single escape function does not protect every context.

text.en: What does a template that encodes automatically prevent?

explanation.en: Every value is encoded by default.

text.tr: XSS açıklarının çoğu şablonlarda nereden çıkar?
text.en: Where do most XSS holes in templates come from?

tr: Kodlamayı kapatan işaretlerin yanlış yerde kullanılmasından
en: Markers that switch encoding off being used in the wrong place

explanation.en: "Raw" or "safe" markers.

text.tr: Kullanıcı biçimli metin yazabilmeliyse ne yapılır?
text.en: What is done if the user must be able to write formatted text?

tr: İzin listeli, bakımı süren bir temizleme kütüphanesi
en: A maintained sanitising library with an allow list

explanation.tr: Kara liste hep bir şeyi unutur.
explanation.en: A block list always forgets something.

text.en: What is CSP?

tr: Sayfada hangi betiklerin çalışabileceğini tarayıcıya söyleyen başlık
en: A header telling the browser which scripts may run on the page

explanation.en: Content Security Policy.

text.en: What does `script-src 'self'` allow?

tr: Yalnızca aynı siteden yüklenen betik dosyalarına
en: Only script files loaded from the same site

explanation.en: A leaked embedded block does not run.

text.en: What does `'unsafe-inline'` do to a CSP?

en: It removes the protection against embedded scripts

explanation.en: Its name says so.

text.en: What is CSP to encoding?

en: A second layer, not a replacement

explanation.en: Against a missed mistake.

text.en: What does an `HttpOnly` cookie provide against XSS?

en: A leaked script cannot read the cookie

explanation.tr: Kullanıcı adına istek göndermeyi yine engellemez.
explanation.en: It still does not stop requests in the user's name.

text.en: When is data encoded?

en: When it is written into the place it goes
When it is saved to the database

explanation.tr: Aynı veri HTML'e, JSON'a farklı kodlanır.
explanation.en: The same data is encoded differently for HTML and JSON.

text.tr: `<script>` kelimesini silen bir süzgeç neden yetmez?
text.en: Why is a filter that deletes the word `<script>` not enough?

tr: Betik çalıştırmanın tek yolu o etiket değildir
en: That tag is not the only way to run a script

explanation.en: A block list forgets; encoding does not.

text.tr: Derste şablona `Ada` verilince çıktı ne oldu?
text.en: In the lesson, what was the output when `Ada` was given to the template?

explanation.en: Every value was encoded.
